The '''ASUS''' P/N of this device is ME571KL (K009). Per the FCC test report... *The mainboard model is ME571K_MB. *The device is using a '''Qualcomm''' APQ8064 ({{WPLink|Snapdragon_(System_on_Chip)}}), 1067 NSP *The Wi-Fi IC is a '''Qualcomm Atheros''' WCN3660 (802.11a/b/g/n, 1x1:1) *The WWAN RF FEM is a [http://www.qualcomm.com/media/documents/files/4g-world-2012-global-multimode-carrier-aggregation.pdf WTR1605L] (multi-band 4G LTE) *The LCD panel in use is a '''JDI''' ([http://www.j-display.com/english '''Japan Display Inc.''']) LT070ME05000. *The battery in use is an '''ASUS''' C11P1303 - 3.8VDC, 3950mAh / 15Wh *The front-facing camera (1.2 MP) is a '''Lite-On''' 12P2SF181. *The rear facing camera (5 MP) is a '''Chicony''' CJAC53220003870LH. *The eMMC is stated to be a '''hynix''' H26M64003DQR (32GB). *Chargers mentioned are.. **ASUS PSM06A-050Q (100-240VAC ~ 50/60Hz, 0.25A -> 5.2VDC, 1.35A) **ASUS PA-1070-07 (100-240VAC ~ 50/60Hz, 0.3A -> 5.2VDC, 1.35A) [http://forum.xda-developers.com/showthread.php?p=42579685 This is apparently (and not surprisingly) the '''Google''' Nexus 7 LTE 2013 model]. {{WiFiCert|WFA19518|07/08/2013}}
